notes.title: Update - Version 1.2 (Achievements Added)
notes.content:
Other than the addition of achievements, other changes have been applied and are listed below.

- Health now regenerates (albeit somewhat slowly)
- Enemies deal more damage
- Minor tweaks to enemy A.I.
- Minor tweaks to platforming abilities

If you haven't received this update yet, you may need to reinstall this game (15MB). Thank you very much for your support and patience.

notes.title: Hikikomori No Chuunibyou - Vote on Greenlight!
notes.content:
My latest game, Hikikomori No Chuunibyou, is currently on Greenlight for voting. Please do take a look at it through [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=683486364]here[/url].

Hikikomori No Chuunibyou is a pseudo 8-bit platform-adventure game with beat-em-up, puzzle, and stealth elements. With its storytelling directing the player through open-ended levels, progression through each stage requires usage of parkour-like abilities and martial-arts techniques.

Like all of my other games, I developed it in its entirety on my own.

notes.title: Nil-Ninjahtic: Ronin - Vote on Greenlight!
notes.content:
A sequel to this game, entitled Nil-Ninjahtic: Ronin, is currently on Greenlight for voting. Please do take a look at it through [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=554088148]this link[/url].

Nil-Ninjahtic: Ronin is a pseudo 8-bit action platformer. It combines much of the gameplay aspects of the previous titles in the series in a manner that differentiates it from its predecessors, minding the feedback received on those titles through Steam reviews, forum posts, and Let's Play videos.

It is currently available through [url=http://blazeepic.itch.io/nil-ninjahtic-ronin]itch.io[/url] and [url=http://sites.fastspring.com/blazeepic/product/nilninjahticronin]FastSpring[/url] for $1.99 USD. If Greenlit, Steam keys will be provided to customers who had purchased the game through either of those sites.

notes.title: Update - Version 1.0.2.6
notes.content:
These are the changes I have made for this update:

- Most screens no longer require dispatching all enemies within to proceed

- Enemies require less hits to defeat and are more aggressive

- A few minor changes to the script
